While price may be a significant factor in the evaluation of offers, proposals will be evaluated according to “best value” procedures on the basis of Price, Past Performance, Delivery and  Small Business Participation.

This solicitation will be available on the Internet at http://www.dibbs.bsmdla.mil/rfp on or about (04/27/2026). Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. 

DLA internet Bid Board System (DIBBS) offers are acceptable for this solicitation. Offerors must complete the entire solicitation. Offers must be submitted on a hard copy of this SF 33 Request for Proposal (RFP), scanned and uploaded through DIBBS. (Preferred Method) or email proposal to: Bolarinwa.Adeleye@dla.mil)

UPLOAD PROPOSAL THROUGH DIBBS (PREFERRED METHOD)

One or more of the items under this acquisition may be subject to an Agreement on Government Procurement approved and implemented in the US by the Trade Agreements Act of 1979. All offers shall be in English and in US dollars.  All interested suppliers may submit an offer.

Based on market research report, this material is not commercial; therefore, the Government is using the policies contained in FAR Part 15 in its solicitation for this item.  However, interested suppliers may identify with the Contracting Officer their interest and capability to satisfy the Government’s requirement with the commercial item within 15 days of this notice.

This requirement will be solicited IAW FAR part 15.

The NIST SP 800-171 DoD Assessment Methodology is located at:  https://www.acq.osd.mil/dpap/pdi/cyber/strategically_assessing_contractor_implementation_of_NIST_SP_800-171.html

•If contractors have questions related to interpreting or conducting their assessment, please advise them to contact their DCMA representative or the DCMA general mailbox at:  dcma.lee.hq.mbx.dibcacscheduling-inbox@mail.mil.
